evidence.locator: text: Section 2(b)-(d) and the three paragraphs following Section 2(d) (same-license terms apply to a distributed or published work based on the Program as a whole, while the source-request facility additionally reaches qualifying modified programs used through a network; separate independent works and mere aggregation are excluded)

text: introductory paragraph before the Preamble (GPL modification adding Section 2(d) to cover network use), Preamble, and Section 2(b)-(d) (whole-work same-license copyleft plus a network source-request condition)

text: Section 1 and Sections 2(a), 2(c), and 2(d) (copies must carry copyright, warranty, and license notices and the license; modified files need dated change notices; qualifying interactive and network programs require operational user-facing announcements or source-request facilities)

text: Section 1; Sections 2(a)-2(d) and the whole-work paragraphs following Section 2(d); Section 3; and Section 6 (preserve copyright/license/warranty notices and provide the license, mark changes, license a covered whole under this License, provide corresponding source on object-code distribution, preserve an existing network source-request facility in qualifying modified versions, and impose no further restrictions); Section 2(d)'s actor, inherited-facility, modification, network-interaction, immediacy, HTTP, and complete-source conditions are not losslessly represented by the vocabulary, represented by unknown

text: final Preamble paragraph and Section 7, together with complete license review (the text states a patent-policy objective and conditions distribution when external patent obligations conflict, but contains neither an express patent grant from contributors nor patent-litigation termination)

text: Section 0, second paragraph; Sections 1-2; and Sections 4-6 (running is unrestricted; copying, distribution for a fee, and modification are permitted subject to conditions; recipients obtain their license directly from the original licensor, and no express patent grant or general sublicensing permission is stated)

text: Sections 4 and 6-8 and Sections 11-12 (noncompliant acts terminate rights, further restrictions are prohibited, conflicting patent or other obligations can bar distribution, optional geographic limitations may be added, and warranty and liability are disclaimed); the vocabulary has no geographic-limitation value and cannot fully encode Section 7's conflict rule, represented by unknown

metadata: deprecated=true; comments: 'Use the license identifier AGPL-1.0-only instead of AGPL-1.0'; text: Section 9 (a later-version choice exists only when the Program's own notice says 'any later version', while an omitted version number has a separate any-version rule, so this deprecated bare identifier must not substitute for the explicit -only/-or-later choice)

text: Sections 1-3 and 5 (distribution and modification activate stated conditions); Section 2 opening, Section 2(b), and the whole-work/aggregation paragraphs (covered derivative or collective combinations activate whole-work terms, but mere aggregation does not); Section 2(d) (network interaction triggers its source-request duty only for a modified version when the received Program was network-interactive and already offered users such a facility); linking is not expressly addressed and the conditional conjunction for Section 2(d) is not losslessly represented, represented by unknown
